items.description:
The bonds between dragons are unbreakable regardless of generation—run the streets of Honolulu in *Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth*, a direct turn-based RPG sequel to *Yakuza: Like a Dragon* and the ninth entry in this historic SEGA franchise! Hungry newcomer to the underground syndicate Ichiban Kasuga teams up with down-on-his-luck veteran Kazuma Kiryu in this Pacific-spanning adventure. As you fight your way to the top together, experience the unmistakable deep, dynamic, and borderline absurd combat unique to the Like a Dragon series, which mashes outlandish jobs with exceptional techniques. If you’re not already a fan of hilarious action that packs heart, then *Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth* is a fantastic entry point.\
\

items.description:
Kill, die, learn, repeat—like any roguelite worth its weight, *Dead Cells* has the addictive gameplay loop fans of the genre crave. Battle your way through an ever-changing castle filled with Metroidvania-esque paths and treasures to be discovered. From a side-scrolling perspective, you will navigate platforming environments while engaging in frenetic melee-style combat against fantastical creatures. Your patronage today unlocks *The Bad Seed* DLC, which features two new levels filled to the brim with late-game monsters and bosses finely tuned to push you to the limit. With no checkpoints, setbacks are expected, but your skills and determination will lead to success…eventually, muhahaha.\
\

items.description:
Let's go back to the ‘90s, where side-scrolling beat 'em ups dominated and the Turtles were kings! *TMNT: Shredder’s Revenge - Ultimate Edition* lets you send the Foot Clan packing in faithfully recreated vehicles like the tubular Turtle Van as Mikey, Don, Raph, or Leo from Manhattan to Coney Island. Enjoy stunning full-color pixel art and an unmistakable retro aesthetic that draws direct inspiration from the iconic 1987 animated series. This Ultimate Edition marks the video game debut of Mondo Gecko and Mona Lisa, two beloved TV show characters who offer fresh ways to administer pain to gnarly goons! Sounds pretty bossa nova, huh? Cowabunga!\
\

items.description:
Take your love of cards and deckbuilding into the world of roguelike gaming with *Decktamer*. Defeat and capture monsters for your collection as you recruit enemy cards to your party while you explore the depths of a treacherous abyss. Legend says that anyone brave enough to reach the bottom will find unfathomable treasures, but as you descend, the monsters grow more dangerous and unsettling. Grow your team of monster cards, but be careful—if one dies, the card is gone forever! Will you permanently slay your foes or tame them into powerful allies? Strategize any way you wish in *Decktamer*.\
\

items.description:
In a world decimated by more than 200 years of conflict with interdimensional undead armies, you must harness their evil powers to strengthen yourself and reclaim this realm in *Conquest Dark*. High-octane action and roguelite progression collide, with each run delivering satisfying growth, triumphs, and failures. Choose your playstyle from legendary classes like the untameable Barbarians of the Lion, the divinely endowed Oathkeepers, or the mystical Acolytes of Kuu, and send the Black Planet’s undead forces packing! Delete hordes of enemies with ease using wave-clearing eldritch abilities, legendary spells, and unique weapons claimed by slaying bosses as you progress through deep action-RPG runs. Are you brave enough to defeat the undead? Test your Ritual might today!\
\

Chaos is wreaking havoc across the realm, and it’s your mission to reclaim stolen order in *Gatekeeper*. Invite your friends, then choose from nine uniquely designed and gorgeously animated Gatekeepers, each with inventive skills centered around massive hammers, light rifles, bladed melee claws, and more. Every battle in this endlessly replayable roguelike earns you experience to fully unlock each Gatekeeper’s powers—then combine your allies’ abilities to unleash devastating team-up attacks! Collect over a hundred game-changing artifacts that offer a change of pace and grow your capabilities on the battlefield.\
\

items.description:
Stack ‘em real high in *Pile Up!*, the strategic building game where you build houses, fulfill maintenance requests, and manage your properties to maximize profits and fun! Working on the principle of verticality, streeeeetch your unique buildings to the sky and watch your population grow. Progress to unlock blueprints for new structure combinations and strategies—there are more than 50 styles to mix and match. Befriend adorable companions across three islands, and maybe you'll meet Moby Jr. the Whale! Mayhem awaits on every floor as you create without limitations—if you love controlled randomness, then *Pile Up!* is the game for you!\
\

Take control of a party of relic hunters in an epic tale of destiny. Set in a war-torn world, *Dark Envoy* offers skill-based combat and classic team-based RPG mechanics that deliver thrilling action and deep storytelling. Form your party to match your playstyle with twelve distinct class archetypes that specialize in spellcasting, brute strength, agility, and so much more. A rich and diverse upgrade tree alongside five different difficulty settings offers a tailored experience that matches any skill level. Fulfill your destiny and find the most powerful relics today!\
